text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today's training menu with Tamamo Cross was all finished, but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey you, mind if I go run
a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I just got a call from the little ones back home. They told me to 'do your best!'...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that really gets me fired up!
So yeah, I wanna run so bad right now!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best to live up to expectations!
It's important to conserve your strength, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely gonna show the little ones what it looks like when I win a race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Tamamo Cross diligently threw
herself into additional training.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see... Aye, you might be right about that.
There's probably not much we can do
from this point on anyway...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll take a good rest today,
and pour all that energy into tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, Tamamo Cross headed back to the dorm.
